application_mode: CSC (Common Services Centre) Assisted Registration with Biometric Auth
prerequisites: Self-declaration of practicing one of 18 recognized traditional crafts
Minimum age of 18 years at date of registration
Aadhaar card linked with active mobile number
Bank account details (for stipend & tool kit voucher)
No active loan under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra in past 5 years

application_steps.portal_action: Artisan visits nearest CSC. Enters Aadhaar & mobile number. Completes biometric fingerprint scan.
application_steps.verification: Biometric fingerprint authentication via CSC UIDAI terminal.

application_steps.portal_action: Select artisan craft from 18 traditional professions. Enter family details and workshop address.
application_steps.verification: Gram Panchayat Head or Ward Member confirms trade engagement.

application_steps.portal_action: Enter bank details for ₹15,000 tool kit incentive and choose collateral-free loan preference.

input_fields.name: bank_account_number
input_fields.description: Savings bank account for stipend & voucher

input_fields.name: loan_tranche_preference
options: Only Skill Training & ₹15,000 Tool Kit (No Loan)

application_steps.verification: PFMS bank validation and credit bureau verification.

application_steps.step_name: Three-Tier Committee Sanction & ID Card Issuance
application_steps.portal_action: Application passes Tier 1 (Gram Panchayat) -> Tier 2 (District Implementation Committee) -> Tier 3 (National Committee).
application_steps.verification: Tier-1 Gram Panchayat verification, Tier-2 District MSME review, Tier-3 National committee sanction.
application_steps.output_artifact: PM Vishwakarma Digital ID Card and Certificate with QR code issued.

benefits_disbursement.toolkit: ₹15,000 e-voucher via digital payment / UPI for modern tools
benefits_disbursement.loan: Up to ₹3,00,000 collateral-free loan at 5% interest (Subsidized by GoI up to 8%)
